example.title: Mazeppa Ancient Order of United Workmen Building, First Street

brief: Two-storey red-brick commercial block and lodge hall built in 1912 by the local AOUW lodge (founded 1878) in a small Zumbro River village: two storefronts with wood-framed display windows and transoms under a continuous cornice, paired 1/1 upper windows with stone sills lighting the lodge hall, recessed brick panels, a corbelled cornice and a raised central parapet ornament. Several upper sashes are broken; a frame house and a metal shed flank it.

storefronts.sign: DUNMORE FEED & SEED - CO-OP MEMBERS WELCOME
